text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

**1. Notes got better, not just faster.** Reps stopped scribbling and started listening. Discovery calls surfaced more detail on budget and timing.

**2. CRM hygiene improved overnight.** Updates that used to wait until Friday were logged the same day.

**3. Trust took work.** Some buyers hesitated at first. Asking consent upfront and sharing the summary afterward turned that into a plus.

**4. Managers coached differently.** Instead of asking "how'd it go?", they reviewed real moments and gave specific feedback.

**5. Accuracy isn't perfect.** Product names and jargon needed cleanup, so we built a quick review habit.

The tool didn't replace judgment. It gave reps more time to use it.

What has your team learned from AI in the field?
